## Astronomical 0.2.99
### Fixed - The chat window finds its engine by itself. After an update or a fresh launch the window could open a moment before the engine and stay on "Load failed" with no model selector; it now says it is waiting and fills in its models and conversations as soon as the engine answers. - "Check for Updates…" is back in the menu-bar popover's menu. - The menu-bar companion comes back when you return to the chat app if it stopped unexpectedly. - A Neural Engine preparation that stops making progress no longer keeps a model in memory.
### Compatibility - macOS 14.0 or later on Apple silicon. - Installed models, chats and settings are preserved. The configuration format is unchanged.
The disk image is signed with a Developer ID, notarized by Apple and stapled.
